fixture: Disposable database; real local routes and development sign-in; stubbed model; no external network. Does not verify Google OAuth or external integrations.
checks: Pete sees one primary service check, honest Google setup status and collapsed optional details; configuration alone does not earn a green answer status.
An explicit answer-service check reaches the real probe-recording route with a stubbed model; green appears only after the recorded success, and full result/timing remains in Service details.
Failed probe request masks older successful evidence across Refresh status; the mobile recovery runs a new explicit check and restores confirmed status.
Failed health refresh invalidates every green claim, keeps labelled last-known details and recovers through a read without repeating a probe.
Double-clicking a check produces one request; both primary and Advanced views show the same pending state through disclosure changes.
All original capability labels/details and service records/check controls remain reachable. At 390/768/1280px the full board wraps, buttons fit and status text exceeds 4.5:1 contrast.
Shift+Tab wraps to the last visible disclosure; Enter expands it, Tab reaches its real check button, and Escape restores focus to Connections.
Light and dark mobile views retain 4.5:1 status contrast and complete primary controls.
The fictional member retains both primary checks and the full Advanced service board; no new owner-only restriction was introduced.
Malformed connection/service responses fail visibly without invented configuration or green checks; explicit refresh distinguishes a valid empty response from failure.
A simulated available Google account button receives the real fixture server’s unconfigured response; the user stays on Connections with status recovery, and no OAuth or external call is made.

screenshots.description: The first view shows the answer service, Google account availability and clear safety limits. Optional service checks, supported functions and Advanced details start closed.
A failed request keeps its recovery beside the answer service. The previous successful probe cannot remain green after this failure, even when a later read returns that older record.
Every original service remains in Advanced details with readable status, complete service reference, full source text and a reachable 44px check control on mobile.
The simplified account and answer checks retain readable text and complete controls in dark mode.
Mobile Connections starts with readable account access and an answer-service check; all additional functions and diagnostics are available through named disclosures.
A complete empty response gets an explicit no-details message and Refresh status. Malformed responses earlier showed separate errors instead of pretending nothing was configured.
